title: Senior Applied Scientist
description:
**Overview**  

Imagine the possibilities when AI is infused into the core of Microsoft Word—an application people use every day to share ideas, shape them with others, and turn them into reality. Join the Word Mobile and Word Copilot team in Noida to help transform how people create, edit, understand, and collaborate on documents across phones, tablets, web, and desktop. You will work on experiences ranging from the foundational capabilities of a world\-class word processor to new conversational and agentic ways of writing, including mobile\-first Copilot entry points, direct rewriting from a selection, contextual suggestions, and multi\-turn document creation and refinement.


As a **Senior Applied Scientist**, you will develop and evaluate models, prompts, retrieval strategies, and intelligent experiences that connect natural\-language interaction with the Word canvas. You will help Copilot use Work IQ to reason over the files, meetings, emails, chats, people, and organizational context a user is permitted to access, producing grounded and relevant results with enterprise security and governance built in. In a startup\-like, customer\-focused environment, you will partner with product, design, engineering, Microsoft Research, and teams across Word and Microsoft 365, learn from customer feedback and product telemetry, and ship resilient AI capabilities at global scale while accounting for mobile constraints such as limited screen space, latency, intermittent connectivity, and fast task completion.


Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees, we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.

 **Responsibilities**  

* Develop and improve AI models, prompting strategies, retrieval pipelines, and evaluation methods for Word Mobile and Word Copilot scenarios spanning document creation, authoring, comprehension, editing, and collaboration.
* Design grounded experiences that use Work IQ signals—including documents, meetings, emails, chats, people, and organizational context—while respecting permissions, security, compliance, and responsible AI requirements.
* Build mobile\-first Copilot experiences for drafting, rewriting, summarizing, explaining, structuring, and refining content, while preserving the precision, trust, and rich document semantics expected from a world\-class word processor.
* Partner with engineering, product, and design teams across Word and Microsoft 365 to integrate, flight, monitor, and maintain models and agent capabilities across iOS, Android, web, and desktop surfaces, including features and dependencies that span teams and geographies.
* Create rigorous offline and online evaluations for quality, grounding, safety, latency, reliability, and user satisfaction; investigate failures through solid problem\-solving and debugging practices and translate findings into model and product improvements.
* Use customer feedback, product telemetry, service monitoring, and experimentation results to identify emerging authoring needs, validate hypotheses, and prioritize high\-impact improvements for Word and mobile workflows.
* Communicate scientific insights clearly, contribute to design and architecture reviews, grow shared team knowledge, influence cross\-functional decisions, and create reusable methods, publications, patents, or technical artifacts where appropriate.

  

**Qualifications** **Required/Minimum Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's Degree in Statistics, Econometrics, Computer Science, Electrical or Computer Engineering, or related field AND 4\+ years related experience (e.g., statistics predictive analytics, research).
	+ OR Master's Degree in Statistics, Econometrics, Computer Science, Electrical or Computer Engineering, or related field AND 3\+ years related experience (e.g., statistics, predictive analytics, research).
	+ OR Doctorate in Statistics, Econometrics, Computer Science, Electrical or Computer Engineering, or related field AND 1\+ year(s) related experience (e.g., statistics, predictive analytics, research).
	+ OR equivalent experience.

**Additional or preferred qualifications**

**Other Requirements:** Ability to meet Microsoft, customer and/or government security screening requirements are required for this role. These requirements include but are not limited to the following specialized security screenings:

* **Microsoft Cloud Background Check:** This position will be required to pass the Microsoft Cloud background check upon hire/transfer and every two years thereafter.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's Degree in Statistics, Computer Science, Electrical or Computer Engineering, or related field AND 8\+ years related experience (e.g., statistics, predictive analytics, machine learning, or applied research).
	+ OR Master's Degree in a related field AND 7\+ years related experience.
	+ OR Doctorate in a related field AND 6\+ years related experience.
	+ OR equivalent experience.
* Solid programming skills in Python and hands\-on experience with machine learning frameworks such as PyTorch.
* Experience developing, adapting, or evaluating large language models, multimodal models, retrieval\-augmented systems, or agentic AI applications.
* Demonstrated success translating applied research into reliable production services, including experimentation, evaluation, debugging, and performance optimization.
* Publication record or significant industry impact in natural language processing, multimodal AI, human\-AI interaction, information retrieval, or machine learning.
* Experience building grounded AI systems over enterprise or user\-context data, including retrieval quality, citations, permission\-aware access, safety, and responsible AI considerations.
* Experience with mobile or cross\-platform product constraints, online experimentation, telemetry analysis, and quality measurement for customer\-facing AI experiences.
* Solid collaboration and technical leadership skills, with a growth mindset, customer focus, and commitment to inclusive product development.

  

  

This position will be open for a minimum of 5 days, with applications accepted on an ongoing basis until the position is filled.

  

Microsoft is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, ancestry, citizenship, color, family or medical care leave, gender identity or expression, genetic information, immigration status, marital status, medical condition, national origin, physical or mental disability, political affiliation, protected veteran or military status, race, ethnicity, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected by applicable local laws, regulations and ordinances. If you need assistance with religious accommodations and/or a reasonable accommodation due to a disability during the application process**.**

title: Data Science Trainer
description:
**Job Location\- Jaipur**

**Salary\-30000\- 40000 per month**

**Benefit\- Stay\+Food**

**Working Day\- Mon\-Fri**

**Immediate Joiner**

**Company Description** Technoledge™ is an education management and consulting partner that helps universities, colleges, schools, and skill institutions build future\-ready academic ecosystems. The organization focuses on integrating academic excellence, digital transformation, industry collaboration, research, innovation, and student development into a unified, sustainable framework. Its flagship expertise is in establishing Industry\-Driven Centres of Excellence (CoEs) with advanced labs, emerging technologies, certifications, and hands\-on learning across domains such as AI, Machine Learning, Cyber Security, Robotics, IoT, and Cloud Computing. Technoledge™ also provides integrated solutions including AI\-powered digital ERP, academic excellence programs, innovation and incubation support, research and patent guidance, industry partnerships, and international collaborations. The company is dedicated to building connected academic ecosystems that help institutions innovate, excel, and prepare learners for future careers.

**Role Description** The Data Science Trainer is a full\-time, on\-site role based in Noida. The trainer will design and deliver data science curricula, including foundational concepts, statistical methods, machine learning techniques, and practical applications using relevant tools and programming languages. Daily responsibilities include preparing lesson plans, creating teaching materials, conducting interactive classroom sessions and labs, assessing learner performance, and providing feedback and mentoring. The Trainer will collaborate with academic and industry partners to align course content with current trends, support project\-based learning, and contribute to the development of Centres of Excellence in data science and related technologies. The role also involves updating training content regularly, participating in faculty development initiatives, and ensuring a high\-quality learning experience for diverse groups of learners.

**Qualifications**

* Strong foundation in Science Education with the ability to connect data science concepts to real\-world scientific and technological applications.
* Solid understanding of Mathematics, including statistics, probability, linear algebra, and calculus relevant to data science.
* Background in Physics or related quantitative disciplines that supports analytical thinking and problem\-solving in technical training environments.
* Experience as a Qualified Teacher or Trainer, with demonstrated skills in Lesson Planning, classroom delivery, and learner assessment.
* Proficiency in data science tools and languages (e.g., Python, R, SQL) and familiarity with machine learning libraries and visualization tools.
* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or a closely related field.
* Ability to explain complex technical concepts clearly, adapt teaching methods for varied learner profiles, and manage interactive, hands\-on sessions.
* Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work with academic teams, industry partners, and institutional stakeholders.
* Experience developing curricula or training programs for higher education or skill development institutions is an advantage.

**Job Location\- Jaipur**

**Salary\- 30000\-40000 per month**

**Benefit\- Stay\+Food**

**Working Day\- Mon\-Sat**

**Immediate Joiner**

* Food provided

* Data science: 3 years (Required)

title: Assistant Professor - Data Science & AI
description:
About us

AAFT has been providing education in media and arts for the past 30 years. We offer

50 \+ professional courses in various fields of Cinema, Journalism and Mass Communication, Performing Arts, Animation, Hospitality and Tourism, Still Photography, Advertising, PR and Events and Fashion Design.

We go beyond the traditional teaching method and focus more on the

Self\- discovery of students’ potential. AAFT boasts of rich cultural engagement and academic excellence. The Institute attracts students from some of the most popular countries in Asia, Africa, Australia, Europe, North America, and South America.

Company Website: https://www.aaft.com

**Designation: Assistant Professor \- Data Science \& AI (SODSAI**

**Location: Noida, Sector 16**

**Work Mode: 6 Days WFO**

**Shift Timings: 8:30 am \- 4:30 pm**

**Position Summary**

The Assistant Professor – Data Science \& AI will be responsible for delivering theoretical and practical training in Data Science, Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, Deep Learning, NLP, Generative AI, and Computer Vision. The role includes curriculum development, hands\-on project guidance, student mentoring, and keeping students aligned with emerging AI technologies and industry practices.

**Key Responsibilities:**

 Design and deliver AI training sessions covering:

 Python, SQL, Statistics, Advance Excel, Power BI,Tableau

 Machine Learning (Supervised, Unsupervised, Reinforcement Learning)

 Deep Learning (CNNs, RNNs, GANs, LSTMs)

 Natural Language Processing (Transformer, BERT, Encoder\-Decoder, Sequence to Sequence Models)

 Generative AI (LLMs, Transformers, Prompt Engineering)

 Computer Vision

**Requirements:**

 Bachelor’s/Master’s degree in Computer Science, AI, Data Science, or related field.

 3\+ years of hands\-on experience in AI/ML model development and deployment.

 Strong knowledge of Python, TensorFlow, PyTorch, Keras,Scikit\-learn, and ML libraries.

 Familiarity with Generative AI models (ChatGPT, LLaMA, DALL·E, etc.)

 Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, or Azure)

 Prior experience in teaching/training (corporate, academic, or bootcamp) is preferred.

 Excellent communication and presentation skills.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

 Certifications in AI/ML from reputed organizations (e.g., Google, Coursera, Microsoft, DataCamp).

 Experience with MLOps, vector databases, and deployment tools.

 Agentic AI, Responsible AI, Explainable AI skills

 Knowledge of tools like Jupyter, GitHub, Docker, and VSCode.

 Contribution to AI open\-source projects or publications.

Pay: ₹500,000\.00 \- ₹600,000\.00 per year

Application Question(s):

* Current in hand salary?
* Expected in hand salary?
* Notice Period?
* How many years of experience do you have with AI/ML model development and deployment?

Work Location: In person
